title: Segment OrderFlow data tier: deny lateral VNet access to the data subnet
label: orderflow-fault
body:
Demo fault (synthetic). Adds an explicit outbound deny so workloads in the OrderFlow apps subnet can no longer reach the data subnet through the broad VirtualNetwork allow; data-tier access should require a dedicated allow rule.

This pull request is a predefined OrderFlow GitOps demo fault created by the presenter lifecycle. It changes only `scenarios/orderflow/gitops/deploy/network-rules.json` and passes the offline rule check. Merge only during a live demo with an owned environment.
